name: Barangay 183 Hall
about: The Barangay 183 Hall in Blender (blend/build_hall.py) from Ace's Street View shots 266 to 273: a three-storey pink block with green pilasters and bands, an open ground floor under a green awning, a blue-grey glazed top floor, the BARANGAY 183 lettering and the big 183 panel, a pink turret with a blue cap, the rear stair block and water tank, the green fence; turned to face south-south-west as the cameras show.
